headline: CAPTURE OF CSAR HINOSTROZA
content: CSAR HINOSTROZA was captured in Spain after fleeing Peru due to corruption charges. Authorities confirmed his detention provisional without bail for alleged crimes including membership in organized crime, illicit patronage, illegal negotiations prohibited to officials, and trafficking of influence. His extradition process has begun before the Supreme Court of Justice in Spain.

headline: POLITICAL AND LEGAL RESPONSE TO HINOSTROZA’S CAPTURE
content: The capture sparked various reactions among political figures and legal experts. Some praised the governments swift action while others criticized it as a distraction tactic. Legal proceedings against him include investigations led by Prosecutor Jesús Fernández Alarcón who requested preventive imprisonment for 36 months pending further actions.

headline: SUBSTITUTION OF MINISTER MAURO MEDINA
content: Following the escape incident involving former judge CSAR HINOSTROZA, Minister of Internal Affairs Mauro Medina resigned over responsibility issues related to security failures during his tenure. General Carlos Moran replaced him following confirmation procedures conducted swiftly within three days post-resignation announcement.

headline: BARBERING COMPETITION AMONG PRISONERS
